text: unset PROMPT_COMMAND; PS1='> '; pkill -f soffice; sleep 2; python3 -c "import openpyxl" 2>/dev/null || pip3 install openpyxl >/dev/null 2>&1; R=$(python3 -c "import openpyxl,os;p=os.path.expanduser('~/Desktop/best_awards_acl.xlsx');w=openpyxl.load_workbook(p);s=w.active;rows=[('Learned Incremental Representations for Parsing',2022,'Nikita Kitaev, Thomas Lu, Dan Klein','https://aclanthology.org/2022.acl-long.220.pdf'),('Vocabulary Learning via Optimal Transport for Neural Machine Translation',2021,'Jingjing Xu, Hao Zhou, Chun Gan, Zaixiang Zheng, Lei Li','https://aclanthology.org/2021.acl-long.571.pdf'),('Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList',2020,'Marco Tulio Ribeiro, Tongshuang Wu, Carlos Guestrin, Sameer Singh','https://aclanthology.org/2020.acl-main.442.pdf'),('Bridging the Gap between Training and Inference for Neural Machine Translation',2019,'Wen Zhang, Yang Feng, Fandong Meng, Di You, Qun Liu','https://aclanthology.org/P19-1426.pdf')];[s.cell(row=i+2,column=j+1,value=v) for i,r in enumerate(rows) for j,v in enumerate(r)];w.save(p);w2=openpyxl.load_workbook(p);s2=w2.active;print('OK',s2.max_row,s2.max_column,s2['B5'].value)" 2>&1 | tail -1 | tr ' ' '_'); echo -ne "\033]0;${R}\007"
